name_vi: Túi mây pannier một bên xe đạp
description_en: A tall trapezoidal woven pannier with textile roll-top collar, leather rail hooks and rigid back plate, detached. Canonical front: the broad tapering woven face and roll-top strap. Side view: the deep sloping gusset and bottom corner binding. Rear view: a flat mounting plate with two plain rail hooks. All panels, linings, hardware and inserts are completely unmarked; no text, logos, symbols or labels. Keep the identical structure, materials and attachments across all three views.
